tables.title: TABLE I.—DESIGN PARAMETERS FOR LOW-SPEED AXIAL COMPRESSOR
tables.notes: Dot-leader list with no printed column headings; GROUP/ITEM/VALUE/UNIT headings supplied by the transcriber, units split off the value cell as printed. Clearance entries printed as two lines ('1.40-percent span; 0.17 cm'), kept as two rows. Read from image with 2x zoom; second cell-by-cell read done, no changes.

tables.title: TABLE II.—PROBE SURVEY STATION LOCATIONS
tables.notes: Each station prints one or two circumferential positions on stacked lines; split into two columns. Footnote a: 'Looking downstream; top=0°'. Axial position zero reference is not stated. Text layer misaligns this table (do not use it); read from image with 2x zoom; second read done, no changes.

tables.title: Table III.1 Baseline parameters for the Low-Speed Axial-Flow Compressor.
tables.notes: Two-column list with no printed headings; GROUP/ITEM/VALUE/UNIT supplied by the transcriber. Clearances printed as '1.7 mm (1.4% span)' and '0.85 mm (0.70% span)', each kept as two rows. Text layer scrambles the value column order (do not use it). Read from image with 2x zoom; second read done, no changes.

tables.title: Table V.1 Measured seal-tooth clearances for the first set of tests conducted on the LSAC.
tables.notes: Spanning heading 'Seal-Tooth Clearance, ε / h, %' merged into each column heading; row 2 unit '%' taken from that heading. Nominal = four-stage average (text, p. 25); every Nominal cell checked against the mean of the four stages (agrees to rounding). Second read done, no changes.

tables.title: Table V.2 Measured seal-tooth clearances for the second set of tests conducted on the LSAC.
